status: Actions over published libraries; edits report what a save would lose.

layers.label: Tools
layers.summary: Seven tools, the same for every format: discover actions, inspect, read, find, edit, create, convert.
layers.limitations: Edits save in place after a revision check; new files never overwrite.

evaluation.summary: Tested on generated documents of every format.

operations.name: office_actions
operations.description: List the actions office_edit and office_create accept, with each action's fields. Filter by format (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf) and family.

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

operations.name: office_inspect
operations.description: Outline a file: its structure with addresses, its revision (needed by office_edit), and anything its library cannot keep when saving.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to the first folder OfficeMCP may use (the project).

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

operations.name: office_read
operations.description: Read the content at an address (body/p[3], Sheet!A1:D20, slide[2]/shape[5], page[4], ...), or page through the whole file without one.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to the first folder OfficeMCP may use (the project).

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

operations.name: office_find
operations.description: Find text in a file; returns the addresses where it occurs.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to the first folder OfficeMCP may use (the project).

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

operations.name: office_edit
operations.description: Apply actions to a file, all or none, and save it in place (or as a new file with output.path). Refuses if the file changed since expectedRevision, and if saving would lose content unless allowLoss is true. dryRun checks everything without writing.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to the first folder OfficeMCP may use (the project).

expectedRevision.description: The revision office_inspect or office_read returned.

items.description: One action: {"action": name, ...the fields office_actions lists for it}.

actions.description: Actions applied in order, all or none.

path.description: A new file's path, in an existing folder OfficeMCP may use; an existing file is never overwritten.

output.description: Save as this new file instead of in place.

allowLoss.description: Save even if the fidelity check finds content the save would lose; the result lists it.

recalculate.description: Workbooks: recalculate formulas with LibreOffice before writing.

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

operations.name: office_create
operations.description: Create a new file at a path, applying actions to it. A new PDF is built from compose actions (add_heading, add_paragraph, add_table, add_page_break).

path.description: A new file's path, in an existing folder OfficeMCP may use; an existing file is never overwritten. It ends in the format's extension.

items.description: One action: {"action": name, ...the fields office_actions lists for it}.

actions.description: Actions applied in order, all or none.

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

operations.name: office_convert
operations.description: Convert a file to a new file, next to it unless output.path says where: to txt from any format, to csv from a workbook (one sheet), to pdf from docx, xlsx or pptx (needs LibreOffice).

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to the first folder OfficeMCP may use (the project).
A new file's path, in an existing folder OfficeMCP may use; an existing file is never overwritten.

sheet.description: csv: the sheet; the first otherwise.

code.description: When refused: a stable reason code.

hint.description: When refused: what to do next.

layers.label: XLSX
layers.summary: 10 actions. Addresses: Sheet, Sheet!B2, Sheet!B2:D9, Sheet!B:D, table[Name].
layers.limitations: openpyxl does not calculate formulas: edits report recalculationNeeded, and recalculate needs LibreOffice. Rows are not inserted or deleted in the middle of a sheet.
